dedupeResult: The complete open pull-request patch and repository code search were checked for 4ZZZ, the canonical domain, the canonical form path and the Music Department follow-up mailbox. No prior music-submission-agent record was found. The canonical form is stored once; the follow-up mailbox, individual-announcer service routes and Australian-only Album of the Week form are not counted as separate MarcsMusic opportunities.
emailVerificationLevel: 4ZZZ's official Contact page publishes music-department@4zzz.org.au in plaintext specifically for following up an existing submission. The address has valid syntax and exact official-domain alignment, but the same page directs initial music delivery to the online form. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
safety: No form field, email, direct message, audio file, downloadable link, download code, biography, metadata, personal or optional identity information, cover art, social link, permission checkbox, login, CAPTCHA, consent or payment was entered or submitted. No individual announcer was contacted, no postal route was inferred and no anti-bot, authentication, platform or payment restriction was bypassed.
